meta.meta_link_rule_2026_09_25: Decision 115. Founder rule, 25 Sep 2026: no link of any kind ever goes in a Facebook or Instagram post body or caption, because Meta suppresses posts that carry one. The post names the CTA in words and points to the comments. The link goes ONLY in the first comment, set to post automatically 5 minutes after the post's scheduled publish time; where the scheduler cannot do that, the comment goes up by hand 5 minutes after the post is live, and no post is reported done until its first-comment link is seen live. Skool links are never a raw URL: anywhere a link can sit behind words (Skool posts, comments and lessons, email, site, PDFs) a Skool link is a hyperlink buried in the CTA words. content_calendar_rules.rollout: Two-week rollout. Research starts at the beginning of the last week of the preceding month. One week of posts is released every 3–4 days across the last week of the preceding month and the first week of the covered month, each week tested and scheduled before it runs. content_calendar_rules.purpose: The calendar organically promotes TDIE and its paid tiers. Anything inside TDIE is fair game. content_calendar_rules.sale_window_rule: Decision 110 (24 Sep 2026). A price-increase or flash-sale window runs 4–5 days at most, with only a few days' heads-up before it opens. Never announce an increase a month out.
content_calendar_rules.meta_links: Decision 115 (25 Sep 2026). No link in any Facebook or Instagram post body or caption. The link goes only in the first comment, 5 minutes after the post publishes. Skool links are always hyperlinked CTA words, never a raw URL, wherever a link can sit behind words.

spread_rules.rule: Replaces the old posting-day rules (no membership Tue to Thu, Vault Wednesday only, Vault/membership never adjacent, Premium Monday or Friday only, weekly affiliate cap of three). Affiliates never same or consecutive days, never the same product twice a week. Nothing repeats inside 14 days.
spread_rules.instagram_no_links: Instagram carries no links anywhere, ever — captions, comments, first comments, replies. Calls to action point to the link in bio. Story link stickers are excepted. Facebook's first-comment rule is unchanged (see meta_links).

Not AI-perfect, not a five-million-dollar mansion, not messy. Clean and natural, with the evidence of kids, dogs and farm animals in the room rather than the mess of them. Decor that suits her and complements the farmhouse.
image_prompts.register_scope: This governs persona PHOTOGRAPHY. The luxury-campaign register in the Prompt Library governs pin DESIGN. Not interchangeable.
image_prompts.standalone_rule: Every prompt is a complete standalone unit. Every image in a carousel or story set gets its own complete prompt — never a shared spec block plus fragments.
image_prompts.text_rule: Nano banana (Gemini): text is set, never generated — no lettering in frame. Canva AI renders text accurately; do not strip text from Canva prompts.
